description: One entry per asset (Bitcoin, ETH, SOL, USDC, USDT and every other tracked stablecoin, tokenized Treasury and L1) with its best current yield across DeFi and CeFi under BitcoinYield's risk-weighted ranking, its A-D risk grade, and a link to the full comparison. by_grade gives the best proven rate at grade A, B and C (A = lower risk), the tradeoff a holder chooses between: a grade is null when nothing proven at it pays materially more (at least 0.05 points and 5%) than a safer grade. best_apy and each by_grade rate are in percent, as the asset page quotes them (today's rate, or its 7-day average when today's is a spike above it), and rate_basis says whether the source quotes an APY or an APR. Set max_risk to limit every pick to offers graded at or below that letter. Rates are variable and not advice. No key required.

asset.description: Filter to one asset by its symbol, e.g. BTC, USDC or USDE.

max_risk.description: Only consider offers graded at or below this letter: A (lower risk), B (moderate), C (elevated), D (higher).

stablecoin.description: Set to "true" to return only stablecoin assets.

name: list_yields

degraded_sources.description: The sources missing from this snapshot, if any.

partial.description: True when a data source was missing from this snapshot.

stale.description: True when part of this snapshot is over 6 hours old (a scheduled refresh was missed).

updated_at.description: When the feed was last refreshed (ISO 8601). It refreshes every 3 hours.

best_apy.description: The pick's rate in percent (5.2 means 5.2%) as its page quotes it: today's rate, or its 7-day average when today's is a spike above it. An APR when rate_basis says so; the name is kept for compatibility.

by_grade.description: The best proven rate at each risk grade (a month of steady history and $10M or more to exit into). A grade is null when no proven offer of it pays materially more (at least 0.05 points and 5%) than a safer grade.

market.description: The vault, market or token the rate is paid in.

rate.description: The step's annual rate in percent as its page quotes it: today's rate, or its 7-day average when today's is a spike above it.

rate_today.description: Today's reported rate; differs from rate only on a spike.

url.description: This grade's offers on the asset's page.

us_available.description: Whether a US retail user can open it.
